12: WHO Classification. Serum Gonadotropins & Serum Estradiol levels. WHO I: FSH & LH ↓ & Estradiol ↓. WHO II: FSH ~ & Estradiol ~; PCOS. WHO III: FSH & LH ↑ & Estradiol ↓.
13: WHO 1: no FSH stimulation. WHO 2: advanced follicle maturation arrest. WHO 3: no follicles.
14: Causes of primary amenorrhea. Hypothalamus: Constitutional delay; Functional hypothalamic amenorrhea; Isolated GnRH deficiency. Anterior pituitary: Hyperprolactinemia; Pituitary tumors. Ovary: Primary ovarian insufficiency; Gonadal dysgenesis; Gonadal agenesis; Polycystic ovary syndrome. Genital outflow tract and uterus: Congenital abnormality in Müllerian development; Congenital defect of urogenital sinus development.
15: Secondary amenorrhea. Hypothalamus: Functional hypothalamic amenorrhea. Anterior pituitary: Hyperprolactinemia; Pituitary tumors; Pituitary infarction. Ovary: Polycystic ovary syndrome; Primary ovarian insufficiency; Ovarian tumors; Menopause. Genital outflow tract and uterus: Cervical stenosis; Intrauterine synechiae.
